name: target-ldl-goal
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P:
1. HLD: LDL goal < 70, discussed diet.
note: A treatment target is not a measured value. Reading 70 as the LDL would drive the guideline layer off a number the patient never had.

name: target-bp-goal
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P:
1. HTN: BP goal < 130/80.
note: A BP goal is not a reading.

name: target-a1c
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P:
1. DM: target A1c < 7
note: An A1c target is not a result.

name: target-total-chol
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Plan: goal total cholesterol under 200
note: A cholesterol goal is not a lab value.

name: target-bmi-goal
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Plan: weight loss, goal BMI < 25
note: A BMI goal is not a measurement.

name: target-bmi-explicit
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Target BMI 24.9 by next visit
note: 'Target BMI 24.9' is the aim, not the current BMI.

name: target-cue-after-number-still-parses
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP 128/78, at goal on lisinopril 20 mg
note: 'at goal' describes the state and sits AFTER the reading, so 128 is a real systolic.

name: goals-of-care-is-not-a-target
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Goals of care discussed with family. BMI 31.4
note: 'Goals of care' is a conversation, not a treatment target; the BMI on that line is real.

name: family-bmi-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Mother: obesity, BMI 41
note: A relative's BMI must never become the patient's.

name: family-chol-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Father: hyperlipidemia, total cholesterol 310
note: A relative's cholesterol must never become the patient's.

name: family-bp-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
Father: HTN, BP 180/110
note: Unindented but led by the relative's name - still the father's reading.

name: family-a1c-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Mother: T2DM, A1c 9.2
note: A relative's A1c must never become the patient's.

name: family-egfr-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Mother: CKD, eGFR 22
note: A relative's eGFR must never become the patient's - this one would have moved the risk a long way.

name: patient-vitals-after-family-block
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Mother: obesity, BMI 41
Vitals: BMI 31.4
note: A new left-margin label line ends the family-history block, so the patient's own BMI is still read.

name: patient-labs-after-family-block
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Family History:
  Mother: T2DM, A1c 9.2
Labs: Chol 198, HDL 51
note: The patient's labs parse; the mother's A1c does not.

name: bmi-euro-decimal-comma
note: A European decimal comma must not truncate a BMI of 31,4 to 31.

name: bmi-increased-from-to-takes-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI increased from 28.1 to 31.4 over 2 years
note: In a 'from A to B' trend the current value is B; taking 28.1 would understate the risk.
